project_name: Namma Metro Blue Line Phase 2A & 2B (Silk Board - KR Puram - Airport)
growth_catalyst_description: Connects Outer Ring Road IT corridor (Bellandur, Kadubeesanahalli, Marathahalli) directly to Kempegowda International Airport. Eliminates up to 65% of road vehicle hours lost on ORR.

project_name: Mumbai Coastal Road (Phase 1 & Phase 2 North Extension to Kandivali)
growth_catalyst_description: Cuts Marine Drive to Kandivali travel time from 120 minutes to 35 minutes. Frees Western Express Highway bottlenecks and uplifts Goregaon-Borivali real estate valuations.

project_name: Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) & Metro Line 12
growth_catalyst_description: Secondary commercial aviation hub handling 60 million passengers, driving exponential plotted and residential appreciation across Panvel, Kharghar, and Ulwe.

project_name: Chennai Metro Phase 2 (118.9 km across Corridors 3, 4 & 5)
growth_catalyst_description: Direct metro line along the entire length of Old Mahabalipuram Road (OMR) IT corridor down to Siruseri SIPCOT, eliminating dependence on road buses.

project_name: Noida International Airport (Jewar) & Yamuna Expressway Aerotropolis
growth_catalyst_description: Asia's largest planned 6-runway airport creating massive industrial and residential demand along Noida-Greater Noida Expressway and Sector 150.

project_name: Hyderabad Metro Phase 2 (Airport Express Line & Old City Line)
growth_catalyst_description: Connects Mindspace Junction, Raidurg, and Financial District straight to Shamshabad RGIA in under 22 minutes.

project_name: Varanasi Urban Ropeway Phase 1 & 6-Lane Ring Road Phase 2
growth_catalyst_description: India's first urban transit ropeway linking Cantt Railway Station to Godowlia Chowk in 16 minutes, bypassing core city vehicular choke points completely.

project_name: Prayagraj Mahakumbh 2025 Permanent Infrastructure & Ganga Expressway
growth_catalyst_description: 594 km Ganga Expressway linking Prayagraj to Meerut/Delhi in 6 hours, plus permanent riverfront bunds insulating North Prayagraj.
